_comment: Practical planning defaults for doors, windows, staircases, and circulation — companion to vastu_room_sizes.json's room-size tiers. Same category-C status: architectural planning conventions, not classical Vastu content (Vastu proportion/placement rules for openings live in entrance.py/zone_rules.py, e.g. door-height-as-ratio-of-width and NE/SW solar window sizing). This file is reference data only, not yet wired into the engine — each section's `current_implementation` block records the constant(s) already live in code (as of this file's version) so the two don't silently drift apart. Units are metres throughout.

doors._comment: width/height are the reference planning size; wall_opening = width + typical frame allowance. current_implementation cites engine/vedic/vastu/entrance.py (DOOR_RATIO, ENTRANCE_W) and building.py/layout.py (DOOR_W, WET_DOOR_W) — those derive height as width * DOOR_RATIO(2) rather than a fixed value, which is why e.g. main door height (1.05 * 2 = 2.10m) matches this table but room/wet door heights (1.80m, 1.50m) run lower than the flat 2.1m reference below.

windows._comment: minimum/preferred are per-room-type planning sizes (width x height). The engine's live sizing (entrance.py WIN_NE_*/WIN_SW_*, building.py) is direction-based rather than room-type-based — a solar wall (N/E, per is_solar_wall) gets the larger WIN_NE_W x WIN_NE_H window at a lower sill, a non-solar wall (S/W) gets the smaller WIN_SW_W x WIN_SW_H at a higher sill — which is itself a Vastu solar-gain convention, not a gap to fill; the two tables answer different questions (how big should this room's windows be vs. how big should a window on this wall be) and are meant to be reconciled together in a later phase, not by replacing one with the other.

staircase._comment: Residential straight/dog-leg planning defaults. Actual footprint should be computed per-project from floor-to-floor height and riser/tread, not hardcoded — see next_legal_count() in entrance.py for the existing even-step-count rule this should compose with.

current_implementation.note: footprint is a fixed 1.25 x 2.5m box today, wider than the 0.9-1.1m reference width above; riser/tread are not yet modeled to derive the footprint from floor height

circulation._comment: Wall thickness and passage clearances to reserve before placing rooms/furniture, so a room's footprint is not mistaken for its usable area.

current_implementation.note: one uniform thickness for all walls today; no external/internal split and no reserved circulation/passage allowance separate from room footprint yet
